units: pixels and seconds; no metric scale recorded

camera.motion: static (no pan/shake): tree trunk, bush, cart and background identical in all 54 frames; a per-pixel median background subtracts cleanly everywhere except where objects move

perspective_cues.far_edge_of_lawn_y_px: about 1000-1045 (base of the background tree line)
perspective_cues.horizon_estimate_y_px: roughly 950-1000 (hidden by trees; distance haze); image centre row is 977

perspective_cues.note: focal length unknown; estimate from the question's depth_info + a known size
